headword: {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}

definitions.explanation: The order in which things should be done based on their importance or urgency.

examples.japanese: {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}をつける。
{優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}の{高|たか}いものから{対応|たいおう}する。
examples.english: We will address items starting with the highest priority.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}を{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to reassess our work priorities.

notes:
A compound of {優先|ゆうせん} (priority) + {順位|じゅんい} (ranking/order). Refers to the order in which tasks or issues should be addressed based on importance or urgency.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}をつける: to set priorities
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い: high/low priority
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}を{決|き}める: to determine priorities
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}に{従|したが}って: according to priority
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}を{見直|みなお}す: to reassess priorities

USAGE:
Very common in business and project management contexts. Often appears in meetings when discussing task allocation or workflow.

RELATED WORDS:
- {優先|ゆうせん}: priority (simpler form)
- {優先|ゆうせん}する: to prioritize
- {重要度|じゅうようど}: degree of importance
- {緊急度|きんきゅうど}: degree of urgency
